text:
Maria: Heads up — flying 12h to APAC for the offsite next month. Anyone have must-listen inflight podcasts and holy-grail neck pillows for red-eyes? Trying not to be a zombie at check-in :grimacing:
Devon: Podcasts — '99% Invisible' for short design stories, 'Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend' if you want laughs, 'The Daily' for lighter news. For long stretches, stash a 10-episode playlist. Offline downloads >>>
Sam: Neck pillow: Cabeau Evolution S3 is my go-to (memory foam with strap). Inflatable ones like Trtl are smaller but less comfy. Also consider a scarf pillow if you want low-profile.
Alina: Compression socks + eye mask + airline earplugs (Mack's) saved me on my last red-eye. E.g. pack: socks, eye mask, earbuds, phone battery pack, nasal spray.
Priya: For sleep: dim the screen, take melatonin (0.5–3mg works for me), avoid alcohol. Short walk every 3–4 hours helps circulation.
Devon: Hot tip: download podcast episodes in the app's highest bitrate to avoid weird buffering. And put your phone in airplane mode but keep wifi on for plane wifi.
Maria: Any recs for battery packs that don't get flagged at security? Mine was borderline but TSA waved it through.
Sam: I use Anker 20,000mAh — always check mAh and bring in carry-on. Also bring a short USB-C cable and an 18W wall charger.
Alina: If you prefer headband-style pillows, check 'Bcozzy' — supports chin so your head doesn't fall forward. Not pretty, but effective :joy: 
Priya: Podcast rec for devs: 'Software Engineering Daily' and 'Command Line Heroes' for long-form tech inspo. For pure chill: 'On Being' or 'LeVar Burton Reads'.
Maria: Thanks all — saving these. If anyone's tried Bose QC earbuds on planes, drop a quick yea/nay.
Devon: Bose QC Earbuds are solid for noise canceling but battery life is meh. I'd bring both earbuds + foam plugs for max quiet.
TravelBot: Reminder: Redwood offsite travel stipend = $200 for APAC flights. See /travel-policy for details :moneybag:
Sam: Also—ziplock for liquids, empty reusable bottle to fill after security. Avoid the annoying 'are those toiletries?' convo.
Alina: One last: pack a fresh set of clothes in carry-on in case luggage is delayed. Learned the hard way. 
Maria: Solid — appreciate the tips! See you on the flight :airplane:
